study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Least-favourable balanced token_delta across cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base on 24 fresh complete eta(<t>) promises, equally weighted across twelve relative-window and twelve absolute-clock cells versus complete English promise mappings.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 24 fresh complete report-back promises, balanced twelve relative windows and twelve absolute clock times
manifest.selection: Pairs were authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure. All tasks and complete pairs are disjoint from target d917feab; every English arm explicitly states the report time, pre-deadline silence rule, and post-deadline breach; each Ainglish arm preserves the task and time.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens per complete pair for each pinned tokenizer; average within each time-form stratum, weight strata equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta.

estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh report-back promises frozen here
estimand.aggregation: equal time-form mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete English promise including both silence semantics, never a shortened paraphrase
estimand.interpretation: price evidence only; it does not establish human comprehension or promise compliance

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
